audit_events_org_required.name: audit_events_org_required
audit_events_org_required.value: "audit_events"."organization_id" is not null or "audit_events"."action" like 'auth.%' or "audit_events"."action" = 'device.claim'

command_targets_reason.name: command_targets_reason
command_targets_reason.value: ("command_targets"."status" = 'failed') = ("command_targets"."reason" is not null) and ("command_targets"."reason" is null or "command_targets"."reason" in ('unsupported', 'permission_required', 'error'))

lessons_ended_consistent.name: lessons_ended_consistent
lessons_ended_consistent.value: ("lessons"."status" = 'ended') = ("lessons"."ended_at" is not null) and ("lessons"."status" = 'ended') = ("lessons"."end_reason" is not null)
